in_sanskrit.name: द्रुवंश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A lineage that is firm and steady, unwavering like the polar star.

in_hindi.name: द्रुवंश
in_hindi.long_meaning: एक स्थिर और निश्चल वंश का नाम है।

in_telugu.name: ద్రువంశం
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఒక స్థిర మరియు అచల పరివారం కూడా ఉంది.

in_marathi.name: Druvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bearer of Druva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Druvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Druva refers to the polar star, symbolizing constancy and direction. Druvansh means 'the lineage of Druva'.

in_bengali.name: Druvansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bearer of Druva
in_bengali.long_meaning: Druvansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Druva refers to the polar star, symbolizing constancy and direction. Druvansh means 'the lineage of Druva'.
